Hi team —

Thanks Ben — and hi Ellie / Tom, pleased to meet you. I’m Marissa, the Customer Success lead assigned to Helix Health. I’m taking ownership of the MAP and onboarding execution from here. Below is a short playbook and owner assignments I’ll be executing with your team. I’ve also attached an updated MAP (MAP_Finalized_20260514.xlsx) that reflects the security checkpoint and the dates Ben proposed.

Immediate owners and responsibilities (Redwood / Helix):
- CS Lead (Redwood): Marissa Cole — overall project owner, escalation contact, pilot success metrics
- AE (Redwood): Ben Carter — commercial/contractual liaison, quarterly business reviews
- Solutions Architect (Redwood): Rishi Malhotra — data connectivity, infra sizing, test-case validation
- Implementation Lead (Helix): Tom Blake — internal technical point-of-contact, data stewards
- Product Sponsor (Helix): Ellie Zhao — executive approvals, acceptance criteria

First 30 days plan (what I’ll do):
1) Kickoff meeting (2026-05-19, 10:00 PT) — introduce detailed owners and walk through the MAP.
2) Data access checklist — Rishi will run an initial connectivity audit and list required credentials (target 2026-05-21).
3) Evaluation test cases — define 3 priority test prompts and success criteria (target 2026-06-04).
4) Pilot execution plan — scheduling, monitoring, and acceptance criteria (target 2026-06-11).

Notes on security/compliance: we received Helix_Security_Reqs.pdf and will route to our security team. Rishi, I’ve flagged two items (data retention policy and access logs) that will likely require a short follow-up with Helix.

Action items for this thread:
- Ben: send the calendar invite for Tue 10am PT and include dial-in + meeting notes template.
- Rishi: prepare a one-page connectivity checklist for kickoff.
- Tom: confirm that you can grant a read-only S3 bucket by 2026-05-21 or tell us an alternate location for test data.

I’ll take the lead on keeping the MAP updated in the shared Drive link below and will post weekly status notes after kickoff. If any of you prefer a different cadencing, tell me now and I’ll adapt.
